R3 example: rows in=0,1,1,0 with reset=0. Row0 prev undefined; row1 prev=0,in=1 no fall -> out stays 0 ok; row2 prev=1,in=1 no fall -> 0 ok; row3 prev=1,in=0 fall -> out=1 ok. Consistent.
R2 condition uses prev_in but contract never defines prev_in initialization; first cycle after reset release prev_in is undefined, so first-cycle falling detection is unspecified.

issues.detail: Spec says output remains 1 until reset; contract R2 uses out<=out|fall (sticky) which matches, but R1 visible same_cycle vs R2 next_cycle creates ambiguity on reset-release cycle when a falling edge coincides.
issues.spec_evidence: the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)
issues.alternative: On the first posedge with reset==0, if prev_in&~in is nonzero, capture the falling edge (out=fall) rather than clearing to 0.
